# TieBot integration pilot overview

The TieBot Integration Pilot explores embedding TieBot’s automated rebar tying system into active construction workflows. This pilot evaluates TieBot’s impact on site efficiency, worker safety, and quality control. Key terms include TieBot Unit (the robotic arm), TieCycle (one complete tie operation), and SyncPoint (integration checkpoints with site management software). Typically, the pilot is owned by the Robotics Deployment Lead in collaboration with Site Operations and Safety teams, ensuring alignment between technical deployment and construction site needs.
